headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
summary: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among Eagles ruled out vs. Jaguars
summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.

headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson out; Huntley to start SNF vs. Falcons
summary: The Ravens are ruling out quarterback Lamar Jackson for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

headline: NFL's longest active Iron Man streak may be in jeopardy
summary: Marc Raimondi provides an update on Jake Matthews' groin injury ahead of what would be his 200th consecutive game starting.

headline: Joe Alt, Derwin James among Chargers ruled out for Sunday
summary: The Chargers won't have either of their starting offensive tackles for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

headline: Vikings list WRs Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison as questionable
summary: Vikings receivers Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) were both listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
